EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Supervisor Assignments (WO)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. I'm happy to help with your supervisor assignments today! The primary supervisor assignment should be made in Insperity Premier, which then imports to the Time & Attendance system. Please see the steps below to make the primary supervisor assignments in Premier:
Log into Insperity Premier:
Single Employee Supervisor Assignment:
Navigate to Company > Manage Employees > Overview > Employees > Select the employee name > Job Information > Position Select the edit option in the Position section Select a Change Reason from the available options in the drop-down menu Enter the Effective Date for change using the calendar provided Select NEXT Select the new Supervisor in the Supervisor drop-down menu
Note: If you don't see the supervisor in the drop-down menu, please reach out to your Payroll Specialist here at Insperity to ensure they have the appropriate access
Select Next Review and confirm the requested change, then select SUBMIT
Mass Supervisor Assignment:
Navigate to Company > Manager Employees > Overview > Employees
Select the company to which the employee belongs (if there is only one account, then no action is needed)
Select Supervisors in the Edit Multiple Employees drop-down menu (on the upper right side of the page)
Select the box next to the employee(s) name
Select MAKE EDITS
Select the reason for the change in the Change Reason drop-down menu
Enter the effective date in the Effective Date field
Select the new supervisor in the Supervisor drop-down menu
Note: If you don't see the supervisor in the drop-down menu, please reach out to your Payroll Specialist here at Insperity to ensure they have the appropriate access
Click on the SUBMIT button
If more than one supervisor should be assigned to an employee, additional supervisor assignments can be made and maintained in the Time & Attendance system. Please reference the link below for those steps:
https://help.insperity.com/bps/knowledge-base/how-do-i-assign-additional-supervisors-for-an-employee/
Please let us know if you have any further questions and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
